items.q: What is the Bilibili title actually asking?
items.a: Not stamina. **Scale.** Almost everyone finishes the clip. Almost no one lives to the Sun's death, which hits in **act one**. Year counter **doubles every ~5 seconds**.

items.q: When does home die on this clock?
items.a: Red giant, then white dwarf, ~**7.65 billion** years. Hitchcock kill: Earth is gone before the film is a third done. That is [[life-as-cosmic-window]].

items.q: What is left after the last star?
items.a: A [[ghost-universe-of-dead-stars]]. White dwarfs cooling toward black dwarfs. Then **zombie galaxies**: holes and light. Mergers ring spacetime — you could hear it if you stood close.
**Ice.** Dark energy (~70%, unknown) does not dilute. Runaway expansion. Last hole evaporates. Photons slide to the same temperature. **Nothing happens, and it keeps not happening.**
Maybe. **Baby-universe lifeboats** — pinch a child cosmos. Infertile universes have no children. The film calls it sheer speculation. Until we know dark energy, we do not know the end.

items.q: Can anything still think in the dark?
items.a: A mind that has **one thought per 10 trillion years** could still count as alive. Pace follows energy. It does not become a human life.
